description: MCP packages with known vulnerabilities, checked by the discovery agent against the package versions it finds in MCP client configs. Version ranges are copied from the 'affected' field of each CVE record in CVEProject/cvelistV5.

packages.fix: Upgrade mcp-remote to 0.1.16 or later, and only connect it to MCP servers you trust.
Upgrade MCP Inspector to 0.14.1 or later; it adds authentication between the browser UI and the proxy.
